messages.en: Has your dad been promoted to colonel?
Yeah, last week. We're planning to have dinner together tonight.
Has the commander arrived at camp yet?
Yeah. He wants to see the platoon leader shortly.

senses.en_definition: An electronic device that stores, processes, and outputs information according to instructions.

messages.en: My computer's stopped working. Just my luck. Can I borrow yours for a bit? I need to submit my assignment before five this afternoon.
Sure. Come over to my place now. I've finished my work.
Have you read that employment contract? Check it over first—don't just sign it.
Yeah, but I want to ask HR about the probation period first.
